senses.gloss: m. (a corrupt. of xenium) a host’s or king’s gift, donation indefinite as to time and amount.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 19b:10">Taan. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>מיום שחרב</he> … <he>נעשו הגשמים ס׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>צימוקין</he>; Ms. M. <he>צומוקין</he>, Rashi ed. Pes. <he>צומוקיון</he>, substitutes for the unintelligible <he>ס׳</he>) since the destruction of the Temple the rains have become irregular and arbitrary gifts, in some years rains are abundant, in others, scanty; in some years rains are in season &c. [Compare the simile: <he>לעבד שנתן לו רבו פרנסתו</he>.]
